entries.passage: Like Raymond Carver, Jane Kenyon writes about her routines in her poem “Otherwise.” She gets out of bed, eats breakfast, has lunch, takes a nap, eats dinner, and sleeps. Nothing special, except that she might have been unable to get out of bed, unable to do all the routines. There are many counterfactuals in “Otherwise.”
entries.translation: 像 Raymond Carver 一样，Jane Kenyon 在《Otherwise》中写日常生活：起床、吃早饭、吃午饭、午睡、吃晚饭、睡觉。没什么特别，除了她本可能无法起床、无法完成这些日常活动。《Otherwise》中有许多这样的反事实设想。

entries.passage: It could have been a lot worse, which makes this typical day precious. It’s clear that she cherishes her mundane life. A meaningful day is not just a day with explicit gains. It is also a day you appreciate because “one day, I know, it will be otherwise.”
entries.translation: 事情本可能糟得多，这使寻常的一天变得珍贵。她显然珍惜平凡的生活。有意义的一天不只是有明确收获的一天，也可以是让你心怀感激的一天，因为“有一天，我知道，一切会变成别样”。

entries.passage: What about a psychologically rich day? Mary Oliver in her poem “Wild Geese” tells us that we don’t have to be extraordinarily good or virtuous, that despair is a part of life, and that insignificance is a part of existence. Even so, she encourages us to be like wild geese: “the world offers itself to your imagination.” The world has so much to offer and explore: “harsh and exciting.”
entries.translation: 那么，心理丰富的一天呢？Mary Oliver 在《Wild Geese》中告诉我们：不必格外善良或有德，绝望是生活的一部分，渺小也是存在的一部分。即便如此，她鼓励我们像野雁：“世界向你的想象力敞开自己。”世界有如此多可提供、可探索的东西：“严酷而令人兴奋。”

entries.passage: A psychologically rich day is a day when you experience something unfamiliar, feel a wide range of emotions, and gain a new perspective on life.
entries.translation: 心理丰富的一天，是你经历陌生事物、感受广泛情绪，并获得新的人生视角的一天。

entries.passage: I wondered whether the key factors of a happy day, a meaningful day, and a psychologically rich day that I identified based on the poems above actually make ordinary college students’ days happy, meaningful, or psychologically rich, respectively. Hyewon Choi and I asked more than two hundred college students to keep daily records of what they did and how they felt for fourteen days, resulting in over 2,600 daily reports.
entries.translation: 我想知道，依据上述诗歌归纳出的幸福、有意义和心理丰富的一天的关键因素，是否也分别让普通大学生的一天幸福、有意义或心理丰富。Hyewon Choi 和我请两百多名大学生连续十四天记录做了什么、感受如何，最终得到超过 2,600 份每日报告。

entries.passage: In addition to asking about happiness, meaning, and psychological richness, we asked them how typical or atypical each day was, how many routine activities they participated in, how much free time they had, and whether they did something new, met someone new, or ate something new. We also presented them with an activity checklist that asked them whether they volunteered, went to a concert, hiked, played a video game, and so on. These daily reports gave us a nice picture of how the students spent their days.
entries.translation: 除幸福、意义和心理丰富感外，我们还问每天典型还是不典型、参加多少常规活动、有多少空闲，以及是否做了新事、遇见新人或吃了新食物。我们还提供活动清单，询问是否做志愿服务、听音乐会、徒步、玩电子游戏等。这些每日报告让我们较清楚地看到学生怎样度过一天。

entries.passage: First, we found some common factors associated with all three aspects of well-being. It turned out that doing something new, eating something new, or meeting someone new enhanced not only psychological richness but also happiness and meaning. That is, most students reported that their day was happier, more meaningful, and richer on a day when they did something new, ate something new, or met someone new.
entries.translation: 首先，我们发现一些与幸福、意义和心理丰富这三个方面都相关的共同因素。做新事、吃新食物或遇见新人，不仅增强心理丰富，也增强幸福与意义。也就是说，多数学生报告，在做新事、吃新食物或遇见新人的日子，他们更幸福、更有意义，也更丰富。这是原书对日记报告结果的表述，不额外改写为随机实验结论。

entries.passage: Second, we found some unique predictors of a psychologically rich day. For instance, an atypical day was psychologically richer than a typical day, but an atypical day was not happier than a typical day. A day with more free time was psychologically richer than a day with less free time. In contrast, a free day was no more meaningful than a less free day.
entries.translation: 其次，我们发现心理丰富的一天有一些独特预测因素。例如，不典型的一天比典型日子心理上更丰富，却并不更幸福。空闲更多的一天比空闲少的日子心理上更丰富。相反，更空闲的一天并不比不那么空闲的一天更有意义。

entries.passage: Finally, a day with more required work was happier and more meaningful than a day with less required work. That is, getting things done made the day happier and more meaningful, whereas doing something unusual made the day psychologically richer. Whether you’re taking a short trip to a vineyard, walking in an unfamiliar part of town, going to a baseball game, or calling an old friend from elementary school, doing something that you don’t usually do is more interesting and psychologically rich than doing things you do every day.
entries.translation: 最后，必须完成的工作更多的一天，比这类工作较少的一天更幸福、更有意义。也就是说，完成事务让一天更幸福、更有意义，而做不寻常的事让一天心理上更丰富。无论短途去葡萄园、走进城里陌生街区、看棒球赛，还是给小学老友打电话，做平时不常做的事，都比每天重复的事更有趣、更具心理丰富性。以上保留原书对报告结果的概括。

entries.passage: Subsequent analyses also showed that a happy day was one in which participants experienced a lot of positive emotions and did not feel many negative emotions. In contrast, a psychologically rich day was one in which they felt more emotions—both positive and negative—than on a typical day. For example, if you are a liberal, watching Fox News might make you upset, but it would be more interesting than watching CNN or another network that more closely reflects your views.
entries.translation: 后续分析还显示，幸福的一天是参与者有许多正面情绪、却没有多少负面情绪的一天。相比之下，心理丰富的一天，是他们比平常感到更多情绪的一天——既有正面，也有负面。例如，如果你是自由派，观看 Fox News 也许会不悦，却可能比观看 CNN 或其他更契合自己观点的频道更有趣。

entries.passage: If novelty, complexity, and perspective change are the key ingredients to psychological richness, studying abroad must rank near the top of the ranking of psychologically rich events. After all, study abroad involves putting yourself in an unfamiliar culture with different landscapes, customs, and norms—a totally new way of life. It’s exciting but also challenging at many levels.
entries.translation: 如果新奇、复杂性和视角变化是心理丰富的关键成分，那么留学必然在心理丰富事件中名列前茅。毕竟，留学让自己进入陌生文化，面对不同景观、习俗和规范——全新的生活方式。这令人兴奋，却也在许多层面充满挑战。

entries.passage: According to the Institute of International Education, 344,099 Americans studied abroad during the 2018–2019 academic year. Due to the global pandemic, during the 2020–2021 academic year the total number of Americans who studied abroad decreased by nearly 96 percent, to 14,549, demonstrating how many college students during the COVID era were deprived of opportunities for exploration.
entries.translation: 根据国际教育协会的数据，2018–2019 学年有 344,099 名美国人出国留学。由于全球疫情，2020–2021 学年美国留学人数下降近 96%，至 14,549 人，显示疫情时期有多少大学生失去了探索机会。这是书中给定年份的历史比较。

entries.passage: Studying abroad is expensive. Airplane tickets. Room and board. New clothes.
entries.translation: 留学很昂贵。机票。食宿。新衣服。

entries.passage: Consequently, it is harder for students from a lower socioeconomic status to participate. I couldn’t have done it myself if I hadn’t gotten the Rotary International scholarship (which paid for full tuition, room and board, textbooks, round-trip airfare, and even a one-month summer English class!). When I got this scholarship, I asked my undergraduate advisor, Professor Hara, where I should go. He was a big fan of liberal arts colleges and recommended three in Maine.
entries.translation: 因此，社会经济地位较低的学生更难参加。如果没获得 Rotary International 奖学金，我自己也做不到；它支付了全部学费、食宿、教材、往返机票，甚至一个月的暑期英语课！获得奖学金后，我问本科导师 Hara 教授该去哪里。他很推崇文理学院，推荐了缅因州的三所。

entries.passage: His assumption was that I would not see other Japanese students and would learn English best there. In July 1991, I left Tokyo for New York City. I spent one month at Wagner College on Staten Island studying English. Then I flew to Portland, Maine, in August.
entries.translation: 他的设想是，我在那里不会遇到其他日本学生，能最好地学英语。1991 年七月，我离开东京前往纽约，在 Staten Island 的 Wagner College 学了一个月英语。然后八月飞往缅因州 Portland。

entries.passage: Dean James Reese picked me up at the airport and drove us up to Bates College in Lewiston. Thirty-plus years later, I still remember our conversation in the car on that warm afternoon. “What is your favorite music?” Dean Reese asked.
entries.translation: James Reese 院长到机场接我，开车带我们去 Lewiston 的 Bates College。三十多年后，我仍记得那个暖和下午的车中谈话。“你最喜欢什么音乐？”Reese 院长问。

entries.passage: “Jazz,” I said. Dean Reese, who is Black, replied, “I love jazz, too!” He then asked, “Who’s your favorite musician?” Somehow the most well-known names, like Charlie Parker and Miles Davis, escaped me at that moment.
entries.translation: “爵士乐。”我说。身为黑人的 Reese 院长回答：“我也爱爵士！”接着问：“你最喜欢哪位音乐家？”不知怎么，那一刻连 Charlie Parker、Miles Davis 这样最出名的名字，我都想不起来。

entries.passage: After a long pause, I said, “Bill Evans.” Dean Reese immediately said, “Get out of here!” I was scared. I thought he meant that I should get out of the car right that moment.
entries.translation: 长长停顿之后，我说：“Bill Evans。”Reese 院长立刻说：“Get out of here!” 我吓坏了，以为他要我当场下车。

entries.passage: Then he explained that another former Japanese student’s favorite musician was also Bill Evans!
entries.translation: 随后他解释，另一位以前的日本学生，最喜欢的音乐家也是 Bill Evans！

entries.passage: I don’t remember many conversations I had in Tokyo with professors, deans, or even friends around that time. Yet many things that happened during my study abroad are still vivid in my memory. For instance, I shared my dorm room with a student named Mike. I’d often pick up the phone and hear, “Is Mike there?”
entries.translation: 那段时期，在东京与教授、院长甚至朋友的许多谈话，我都记不清了。但留学期间发生的许多事情，仍在记忆中鲜明如昨。例如，我与一位叫 Mike 的学生同住宿舍。我常接起电话，听到：“Mike 在吗？”

entries.passage: and I’d say, “No.” Then the voice on the other end usually said, “Could you tell him so-and-so called?” Since I was still learning English, I was never able to make out who this was, so I needed to ask, “Could you please spell it out?” so I could write it down.
entries.translation: 我便回答：“不在。”电话另一头通常接着说：“能告诉他某某来过电话吗？”由于我还在学英语，总听不清对方是谁，就需要问：“能请你拼出来吗？”这样才能记下。

entries.passage: One day, I got a call and followed the same routine. When I asked the speaker’s name, he spelled out, “H-I-S-F-A-T-H-E-R.”
entries.translation: 有一天，我接到电话，照同样的程序应对。询问来电者姓名时，他拼出：“H-I-S-F-A-T-H-E-R。”

entries.passage: I repeated, “H-I-S-F-A-T-H-E-R?” “Yes.” “Great, thanks.” I hung up.
entries.translation: 我重复：“H-I-S-F-A-T-H-E-R？”“对。”“好的，谢谢。”我挂断了电话。

entries.passage: I didn’t realize until I put down the phone that it was Mike’s father! I of course knew the words “his” and “father.” I just could not understand the words on the phone. My listening comprehension of English was very low at that point.
entries.translation: 直到放下电话，我才意识到原来是 Mike 的父亲！我当然认识 his 和 father 两个词，只是在电话里听不懂。当时我的英语听力理解能力很低。

entries.passage: It was humiliating. Indeed, I had never been more humiliated. But this incident made me realize that many immigrants in the U.S. experience similar humiliation, as do many less fortunate people in Japan.
entries.translation: 这太让我难堪了。事实上，我从未如此难堪。但这件事让我意识到，美国许多移民也有类似的屈辱感，日本许多处境较不利的人也是如此。

entries.passage: Until my “his father” incident, I hadn’t thought about how my experience as an exchange student would be similar to immigrants’ experiences in the U.S. Until then, I hadn’t identified myself with other immigrants at all. Of course, I also had a lot of awesome experiences while studying abroad, like going to Acadia National Park and Martha’s Vineyard, where I saw rocky beaches and lighthouses for the first time. This wide range of unexpected experiences and unusual emotions makes studying abroad extremely psychologically rich and rewarding in the long run.
entries.translation: “his father”事件之前，我没想过交换生经历会与美国移民相似，也完全没把自己与其他移民联系起来。当然，留学时也有很多精彩体验，如去 Acadia 国家公园和 Martha’s Vineyard，第一次看到岩石海岸与灯塔。这样广泛的意外经历与不同寻常的情绪，让留学心理上极其丰富，并在长远中带来回报。

entries.passage: Traveling abroad as a tourist is also novel and interesting, but as a tourist you rarely have authentic interactions with locals. Living abroad is much more challenging and evokes a wider range of emotions. In short, psychological richness requires a lot of ingredients, not just novelty but also challenges and perspective change.
entries.translation: 以游客身份出国也新奇有趣，但游客很少与本地人有真实深入的互动。在国外生活更具挑战，也唤起更广泛的情绪。总之，心理丰富需要多种成分，不仅新奇，也有挑战和视角变化。

entries.passage: With this in mind, Jaime Kurtz and I recruited students studying abroad one semester, as well as students who were interested in studying abroad but had stayed on campus. Every week, participants abroad and on campus completed a brief survey similar to the daily diary survey described earlier in the chapter. At the beginning of the semester, study abroad students and on-campus students had similar levels of happiness, meaning in life, and psychological richness.
entries.translation: 考虑到这些，Jaime Kurtz 和我招募了留学一学期的学生，以及有留学兴趣却留在校园的学生。两组每周填写简短问卷，类似本章前述每日日记。学期初，留学与留校学生在幸福、生命意义和心理丰富上的水平相近。

entries.passage: Thirteen weeks later, however, study abroad students reported more psychological richness than on-campus students, though they didn’t differ in terms of happiness or meaning in life.
entries.translation: 然而十三周后，留学学生报告的心理丰富高于留校学生，但在幸福或生命意义方面，两组并无差异。

entries.passage: How come? We looked deeper into the weekly reports and found that study abroad students were far more likely to engage in artistic activities (e.g., going to concerts and museums), shop, party, and take short trips. They were far less likely to engage in club meetings, sporting events, video games, or volunteer activities than on-campus students. Analyses showed that the more artistic activities they engaged in, the richer they reported their lives to be at the end of the semester.
entries.translation: 为什么？深入分析周报发现，留学生更可能参加艺术活动（如音乐会、博物馆）、购物、派对和短途旅行；比留校学生更少参加社团会议、体育赛事、电子游戏或志愿活动。分析显示，艺术活动参加越多，学期末他们自报的人生越丰富。

entries.passage: The other activities were not ultimately associated with psychological richness. Perhaps artistic activities challenge you to expand your perspective more than shopping, partying, or taking a short trip.
entries.translation: 其他活动最终并未与心理丰富相关联。也许艺术活动比购物、派对或短途旅行，更能挑战你去拓宽视角。

entries.passage: In her popular book Bittersweet, Susan Cain contends that “light and dark, birth and death—bitter and sweet—are forever paired” and that negative emotions such as sorrow and longing “make us whole.” She argues that negative emotions play a central role in our emotional lives and make us more empathetic and even more creative. Similarly, I think that negative emotions such as sorrow and longing, along with positive emotions, make our lives psychologically richer.
entries.translation: Susan Cain 在畅销书《Bittersweet》中主张：“明与暗、生与死——苦与甜——永远相伴”，悲伤、渴望等负面情绪“使我们完整”。她认为，负面情绪在情感生活中居核心位置，让人更有同理心，甚至更有创造力。类似地，我认为悲伤、渴望等负面情绪与正面情绪一起，让人生心理上更丰富。

entries.passage: What role does emotional complexity play in psychological richness? In six studies, we explored the role of positive and negative emotions in happiness, meaning, and psychological richness. In all six, those who were leading a happy life experienced a lot of joy, contentment, and pleasantness but infrequently experienced sadness, anger, and fear. Those who were leading a meaningful life were quite similar to those leading a happy life in that they had more positive emotions than negative emotions.
entries.translation: 情绪复杂性在心理丰富中起什么作用？六项研究探索了正负情绪在幸福、意义与心理丰富中的作用。六项研究中，过幸福生活者有许多喜悦、满足和愉悦，却不常悲伤、愤怒或恐惧。有意义生活者与他们相似，正面情绪多于负面。

entries.passage: Interestingly, those who were leading a psychologically rich life experienced a lot of positive emotions but also experienced negative emotions quite a bit.
entries.translation: 有趣的是，过心理丰富生活的人，体验许多正面情绪，同时也相当多地体验负面情绪。

entries.passage: In the final experiment, we tested whether we could make people feel like they had a richer week. Some participants wrote about the best event and the worst event they had experienced over the previous seven days, while other participants wrote about their best event and their second-best event. After the writing task, they evaluated their lives over the previous week, reflecting on how much the writing task had made them think differently about themselves and the world (perspective change, in other words).
entries.translation: 最后一个实验检验，能否让人觉得自己度过了更丰富的一周。有些参与者写此前七天最好和最坏的事，另一些写最好和第二好的事。写完后，他们评价过去一周，反思任务让自己对自身与世界的看法改变多少——也就是视角变化。

entries.passage: We found that compared to the participants who wrote about two positive events, those who wrote about both the best and the worst events reported a greater degree of perspective change. Writing about the worst event, in short, increased the likelihood of perspective change. Most important, the more perspective changes they reported, the psychologically richer they reported their lives to be. Interestingly, the more perspective change they reported, the less happiness they reported.
entries.translation: 相比写两件正面事件的人，写最好与最坏事件的人报告了更大程度的视角变化。简言之，写最坏事件提高了视角变化的可能性。最重要的是，报告的视角变化越多，他们自报的人生越心理丰富。有趣的是，视角变化报告越多，幸福报告越少。

entries.passage: Just as negative emotions such as fear and jealousy add drama to books and movies, the worst event had induced perspective change and made the participants’ lives psychologically richer.
entries.translation: 正如恐惧、嫉妒等负面情绪给书籍和电影增添戏剧性，最坏的事件在这里引发视角变化，使参与者的人生在心理上更丰富。

entries.passage: So what are the ingredients of psychological richness? The examples in this chapter, ranging from Grace’s WWE outing to an atypical day to a semester abroad, had some common elements. Novelty: there’s something different from the same old, same old. Diversity: a wide range of attention and emotion is deployed.
entries.translation: 那么，心理丰富由什么构成？本章从 Grace 的 WWE 之行、不典型的一天到一学期留学，这些例子有共同元素。新奇：有别于一成不变。多样：广泛的注意与情绪被调动。

entries.passage: Challenge: life is more difficult and complex than usual. Memorable: life is vivid. Above all, you learn something new. You gain some new perspective.
entries.translation: 挑战：生活比平时更困难、更复杂。难忘：生活鲜明生动。最重要的是，你学到了新东西，获得了新视角。

entries.passage: Together, our findings paint a clear picture (see also Table 1 in Chapter 1). Simplifying one’s life so as to have reliably positive experiences, or contentment, is key to happiness. Dedicating one’s life to others with compassion is key to meaning. Experiencing the unusual, challenging oneself, and learning new things—though frustrating and unpleasant at times—are key to psychological richness.
entries.translation: 这些发现共同描绘了一幅清楚图景（也见第 1 章表 1）。简化生活，获得稳定的正面体验或满足，是幸福的关键。带着慈悲把生命投入他人，是意义的关键。经历不寻常之事、挑战自己、学习新东西——尽管有时令人挫败或不愉快——则是心理丰富的关键。

entries.passage: As interesting as Joy Ryan and Linda’s lives are, they also feel exceptional. How common is it for ordinary folks to live a psychologically rich life? Is there any scientific evidence that a sizable number of people are leading psychologically rich lives? Our lab set out to quantify psychological richness in people’s lives and determine how common it is.
entries.translation: Joy Ryan 和 Linda 的生活虽有趣，也显得非凡。普通人过心理丰富生活有多常见？有没有科学证据说明相当多的人确实如此？我们的实验室着手量化人们生活中的心理丰富，了解它有多普遍。

entries.passage: We realized that we had a valuable tool to evaluate people’s lives at the end of them, in their obituaries. Every obituary tells a life story. Perhaps by analyzing their contents, we could figure out how happy, meaningful, and psychologically rich a person’s life was. By coding hundreds of obituaries for different life characteristics, we could cover a wide swath of people, from CEOs and politicians to musicians and athletes.
entries.translation: 我们意识到，可以在生命结束时通过讣告评价人生，这是一项有价值的工具。每份讣告都讲述人生故事。也许分析内容，就能了解一个人的生活多幸福、有意义、心理丰富。给数百份讣告按不同人生特征编码，可涵盖从 CEO、政治人物到音乐家、运动员的广泛人群。

entries.passage: We hired three research assistants and asked them to read and rate New York Times obituaries, 101 of them, in June 2016, using twelve different themes. Blind to our hypotheses, they rated the happiness, meaningfulness, and psychological richness of the lives described in each obituary.
entries.translation: 我们聘请三名研究助理，在 2016 年六月阅读并按十二个主题评分《纽约时报》的 101 份讣告。他们不知道我们的研究假设，评价每份讣告所述人生的幸福、意义与心理丰富。

entries.passage: We started by giving the raters clear definitions of a happy life (a life in which a person is comfortable, satisfied, and joyful), a meaningful life (a life in which a person makes a contribution to society and makes a difference), and a psychologically rich life (a life in which a person encounters many diverse, unusual experiences). We then asked them to rate each life, on a scale of 1 to 5, by answering questions such as, “How happy was this person’s life?,” “How fulfilling?,” and “How interesting?”
entries.translation: 首先，我们给评分者明确的定义：幸福生活是舒适、满足、愉悦的生活；有意义生活是对社会作贡献、产生影响的生活；心理丰富生活是遇到许多多样、不寻常经历的生活。然后请他们用一至五分评分，回答“此人的生活多幸福？”“多充实？”“多有趣？”等问题。

entries.passage: We checked that ratings were consistent across the three research assistants before analyzing our data.
entries.translation: 分析数据之前，我们检查了三位研究助理的评分是否一致。

entries.passage: First, how many of the people profiled led a happy life, a meaningful life, or a psychologically rich life? In order for a person’s life to be classified as happy, meaningful, or psychologically rich, the three raters had to assign it an average score of at least 3.67 out of 5 across four items. This is quite a high bar. According to this criterion, fifteen people of the 101 obituaries featured in The New York Times that month led a psychologically rich life.
entries.translation: 首先，这些被介绍的人中，有多少过着幸福、有意义或心理丰富的生活？要归入其中一类，三位评分者需在四项指标上给出五分中至少 3.67 的平均分。这是相当高的门槛。依此标准，当月《纽约时报》刊登的 101 份讣告中，十五人的生活被归为心理丰富。

entries.passage: In contrast, thirty-two people led a happy life, and another thirty-two people led a meaningful life (see Figure 1). In general, then, there were more people who led a happy or meaningful life than those who led a psychologically rich life.
entries.translation: 相比之下，三十二人过着幸福生活，另有三十二人过着有意义生活（见图 1）。总体而言，幸福或有意义生活的人，比心理丰富生活的人更多。

entries.passage: We also looked at how many of them led a happy, meaningful, AND psychologically rich life. There were two who did it all: Nicholas Clinch (lawyer, mountaineer, and onetime executive director of the Sierra Club) and Simon Ramo (engineer, inventor, and author). As can be seen in the Venn diagram below, ten people led a rich and meaningful life, eight people led a happy and meaningful life, and three led a rich and happy life.
entries.translation: 我们还考察，有多少人同时幸福、有意义、又心理丰富。有两人三个维度都具备：Nicholas Clinch（律师、登山家、曾任 Sierra Club 执行主管）和 Simon Ramo（工程师、发明家、作者）。如维恩图所示，十人既丰富又有意义，八人既幸福又有意义，三人既丰富又幸福。

entries.passage: Sadly, forty-one of the subjects were rated to have led neither a happy, meaningful, nor psychologically rich life (of course, their obituaries might have failed to describe relevant events).
entries.translation: 遗憾的是，四十一位研究对象被评为既不幸福、也无意义、也不心理丰富（当然，他们的讣告也许没有写出相关事件）。

entries.passage: That said, New York Times obituaries tend to feature extraordinary individuals, like Muhammad Ali. Certainly, their lives are not representative of the general population. So, next, we hired three other research assistants to code 116 obituaries found in The Daily Progress, a local newspaper in Charlottesville, Virginia, in June, July, and August 2016. We again made sure that the ratings were reliable before analyzing the data.
entries.translation: 话虽如此，《纽约时报》讣告往往报道 Muhammad Ali 那样的非凡人物，其生活显然不代表一般人口。因此，我们另外聘请三名助理，编码弗吉尼亚州 Charlottesville 地方报纸 The Daily Progress 在 2016 年六月、七月、八月的 116 份讣告。分析前同样确认评分可靠。

entries.passage: How many of these Virginians were perceived to have led a psychologically rich life? Using the same criterion (an average of 3.67 or higher on the 1 to 5 point scale), only five out of 116 (4.3 percent) qualified. Is it true that people featured in The Daily Progress are less likely to have led a psychologically rich life? It could be that these folks led less adventurous lives than the cosmopolitans featured in The New York Times.
entries.translation: 这些弗吉尼亚人中，有多少被认为过着心理丰富的生活？使用相同标准——一至五分量表平均 3.67 或以上——116 人中仅五人（4.3%）达标。The Daily Progress 的人物真的更不可能过心理丰富生活吗？也许他们的生活确实比《纽约时报》所写的见多识广者少些冒险。

entries.passage: An alternative explanation is that the obituaries in The Daily Progress are shorter than those in The New York Times, leaving out potentially interesting details. On the other hand, it is noteworthy that sixty-six (or 56.9 percent of subjects) were rated to have led a happy life. Likewise, ninety-six (82.8 percent) were rated to have led a meaningful life.
entries.translation: 另一种解释是，The Daily Progress 的讣告比《纽约时报》的短，省掉了可能有趣的细节。另一方面，值得注意的是，六十六人（56.9%）被评为生活幸福；同样，九十六人（82.8%）被评为生活有意义。

entries.passage: There was one person rated to have led a happy, meaningful, AND psychologically rich life: Henry Saint Dahl (Buenos Aires native, onetime secretary-general of the Inter-American Bar Association, and author of Spanish and French legal dictionaries).
entries.translation: 有一人被评为同时幸福、有意义、且心理丰富：Henry Saint Dahl（生于 Buenos Aires，曾任 Inter-American Bar Association 秘书长，并编写西班牙语和法语法律词典）。

entries.passage: As interesting as these findings are, The New York Times and The Daily Progress mainly feature Americans. We wondered if people lead more psychologically rich lives outside of the U.S. We had two other research assistants code 111 obituaries in The Straits Times, a Singaporean newspaper. How many of the Straits Times folks were rated to have led a psychologically rich life? Forty!
entries.translation: 这些发现虽有趣，但《纽约时报》和 The Daily Progress 主要报道美国人。我们想知道，美国之外的人是否过得更心理丰富。于是另外两名研究助理编码新加坡《海峡时报》的 111 份讣告。多少人被评为心理丰富？四十人！此处人数按原页保留。

entries.passage: That is, 34.5 percent of the people featured in Straits Times obituaries were rated to have led a rich life, far more than in the first two newspapers. Meanwhile, twenty-five (21.6 percent) were rated to have led a happy life, and sixty-five (56.5 percent) were rated to have led a meaningful life. Eight individuals (6.9 percent) were deemed to have it all: happy, meaningful, AND psychologically rich, including I. M. Pei (architect) and Tow Siang Hwa (gynecologist and pastor).
entries.translation: 也就是说，《海峡时报》讣告中 34.5% 的人物被评为心理丰富，远高于前两份报纸。同时，二十五人（21.6%）被评为幸福，六十五人（56.5%）被评为有意义。八人（6.9%）被认为三者兼具，包括建筑师 I. M. Pei 和妇科医生兼牧师 Tow Siang Hwa。注：此处百分比与前片段的“111 份、40 人”不能一致换算；按原页保留，不自行改数字或推定分母。

entries.passage: Our studies demonstrate that a significant number of people lead a psychologically rich life.
entries.translation: 我们的研究表明，相当数量的人过着心理丰富的生活。

entries.passage: It brings us back to the big question: Is it possible to lead a good life without happiness or meaning? Goldmund’s life, for example, was probably rated low in happiness and meaning, but high in psychological richness. The relative independence of the three forms of a good life evident in the obituary studies shows that it is possible to lead a psychologically rich life without happiness or meaning.
entries.translation: 这让我们回到大问题：没有幸福或意义，也能过美好生活吗？例如，Goldmund 的生活大概会被评为幸福与意义较低、心理丰富较高。讣告研究所见三种美好生活的相对独立性，表明没有幸福或意义，也可能过心理丰富的生活。

entries.passage: Indeed, out of the fifteen individuals who were rated to have led a psychologically rich life in the New York Times obituaries, we found four who led a psychologically rich life without happiness or meaning.
entries.translation: 确实，《纽约时报》讣告中被评为心理丰富的十五人里，有四人过着心理丰富、但没有幸福或意义的生活。

entries.passage: In addition, we identified eight individuals in the New York Times obituaries who were rated to have led a rich and meaningful life. Steve Jobs is a real-life example. He was often angry and alienated many people around him. He might not have led a happy life, but it was an interesting one, full of adventures and learning.
entries.translation: 此外，我们在《纽约时报》讣告中找出八位被评为既丰富又有意义的人。Steve Jobs 是现实中的一个例子。他常生气，也疏远了周围许多人。他也许没过幸福生活，却过着有趣、充满冒险和学习的生活。这里的人物例证不等于将他认定为该月讣告样本中的一员。

entries.passage: His life would have been rated low in happiness but high in meaning and psychological richness.
entries.translation: 他的人生本会被评为幸福较低，但意义与心理丰富较高。

entries.passage: Equally important is that some people do lead a psychologically rich as well as a happy and meaningful life. Alison Gopnik’s post–midlife crisis life is just that. So is the life of Linda, the taxi driver. In sum, our research supports that a life of exploration is a distinct kind of good life, a psychologically rich one.
entries.translation: 同样重要的是，有些人确实既心理丰富，又幸福、有意义。Alison Gopnik 中年危机之后的人生如此，出租车司机 Linda 也是。总之，我们的研究支持：探索生活是一种可区分的美好生活，即心理丰富的生活。

entries.passage: But it also shows that it is possible to have two or three of these dimensions of a good life.
entries.translation: 但它也表明，一个人可以同时拥有美好生活中的两种或三种维度。

entries.passage: Are there any personality characteristics that differentiate those who lead a psychologically rich life from those who lead a happy or a meaningful life? To answer this question, we need to know the basics of personality psychology. Since I used to teach an intro to personality psychology class, I’m equipped to deliver this five-minute lecture on the Big Five personality traits.
entries.translation: 有没有人格特征，可以区分心理丰富生活者与幸福或有意义生活者？回答前，需要知道人格心理学的基础。我以前教过人格心理学导论，因此可以用五分钟讲解大五人格特质。

entries.passage: A bit of history first. In 1936, psychologists Gordon W. Allport and Henry S. Odbert set out to identify all the words describing personality or personal behavior in Webster’s 1925 New International Dictionary. That dictionary contained roughly 400,000 entries, of which they found 17,953 personal descriptors, or 4.5 percent of the English vocabulary recorded there. Personality is often defined as characteristic patterns of thinking, feeling, and behavior, so the researchers removed all the words about temporary states, such as “frantic” and “rejoicing.”
entries.translation: 先说一点历史。1936 年，Gordon W. Allport 与 Henry S. Odbert 从 Webster 的 1925 年《新国际词典》中寻找描述人格或个人行为的全部词汇。该词典约四十万词条，其中有 17,953 个个人描述词，占记录词汇的 4.5%。人格通常定义为典型的思维、感受和行为模式，因此研究者删去 frantic、rejoicing 等描述暂时状态的词。

entries.passage: Allport and Odbert also distinguished personality from the moral, evaluative concept of “character.” Their idea was that, in order to establish the scientific field of personality psychology, they needed a judgment-free, relatively neutral vocabulary to avoid biases. So they removed all the character-evaluative terms, such as “excellent,” “acceptable,” and “insignificant.” Allport and Odbert ended up with 4,504 “pure” personality trait words in English.
entries.translation: Allport 与 Odbert 也把人格与带道德评价的 character 区分。他们认为，要建立人格心理学的科学领域，需要不带判断、较中立的词汇以避免偏差。因此删去 excellent、acceptable、insignificant 等品格评价词。最终得到 4,504 个英语“纯”人格特质词。

entries.passage: In other words, they discovered that there were 4,504 different ways to describe someone’s personality, based on the dictionary treatment.
entries.translation: 换句话说，按照这套词典处理方式，他们发现了 4,504 种描述一个人人格的方式。

entries.passage: But why rely on words to illuminate an inner quality? Allport and Odbert argued, “If many human beings were not in fact egotistic, aggressive, or timid, the epithets would not have found a permanent place in language. If traits exist at all it is natural and proper to name them.” If there is a trait name, there must be some corresponding pattern of behavior, thinking, or feeling.
entries.translation: 但为什么靠词语说明内在品质？Allport 与 Odbert 认为：“如果许多人实际上并不自我中心、好斗或胆怯，这些称谓就不会在语言中占有永久位置。只要特质存在，给它们命名便自然且恰当。”如果有一个特质名称，就一定有相对应的行为、思维或感受模式。

entries.passage: Some criticized Allport and Odbert’s research, claiming there were too many synonyms. For instance, the pure personality traits list included both “adventurous” and “venturous.” Are they two separate personality traits? (Not really.)
entries.translation: 有人批评 Allport 与 Odbert 的研究，认为同义词太多。例如，“纯”人格词名单同时包括 adventurous 与 venturous。这真是两种独立人格特质吗？（并不真是。）

entries.passage: Others argued that many of the words, like “aery” and “breme,” were archaic and most people didn’t use them. (Indeed, these words are not very useful.) Yet others argued that there were large individual differences in vocabulary and that esoteric terms should be removed. (Probably true.)
entries.translation: 另一些人认为，aery、breme 等许多词已经过时，多数人不用。（这些词的确不太有用。）还有人说，个人词汇量差异很大，应删去晦涩词语。（大概如此。）

entries.passage: Despite all the criticisms, Allport and Odbert’s early effort to catalog personality trait words has survived as the “lexical approach” to personality.
entries.translation: 尽管遭到这些批评，Allport 与 Odbert 早期整理人格特质词的努力，仍以人格研究的“词汇取向”延续下来。

entries.passage: Later, psychologists had a large pool of participants rate themselves using many of the original Allport-Odbert terms, then applied the statistical technique of factor analysis to sort the terms into larger groups, or “factors.” For example, Lew Goldberg had 187 college students rate themselves on 1,710 terms: “How jolly are you in general? How reserved are you in general? How sadistic are you in general?”
entries.translation: 后来，心理学家让大量参与者用原来 Allport–Odbert 词表中的许多词自我评分，再运用因素分析这种统计方法，把词汇整理为较大的组，即“因子”。例如，Lew Goldberg 让 187 名大学生就 1,710 个词自评：“你一般有多快活？一般有多内敛？一般有多残虐？”

entries.passage: and so on.
entries.translation: 等等。

entries.passage: Goldberg’s study and others like it found that many personality traits cluster neatly into the following five factors: extraversion (e.g., jolly, talkative, sociable, active), neuroticism (e.g., touchy, fearful, self-critical), conscientiousness (e.g., persistent, tidy, dependable), agreeableness (e.g., generous, kind, trustful), and openness to experience (e.g., literary, insightful, perceptive). In a sense, personality psychologists created a map. Like cities and towns across the world, there are countless words descriptive of personality. By classifying all these words into five factors, personality psychologists essentially organized them into “continents” on the map.
entries.translation: Goldberg 的研究及类似研究发现，许多人格特质可以整齐归入五个因子：外向性（如快活、健谈、合群、活跃），神经质（如易怒、胆怯、自我批评），尽责性（如坚持、整洁、可靠），宜人性（如慷慨、友善、信任他人），以及经验开放性（如爱好文学、有洞见、感知敏锐）。从某种意义说，人格心理学家创造了一张地图。像世界各地的城镇一样，描述人格的词数不胜数。把这些词归为五个因子，就相当于把它们整理为地图上的“大陆”。

entries.passage: These factors, known as the “Big Five,” were the most influential discovery in personality psychology in the 1980s and early 1990s.
entries.translation: 这些因子被称为“大五人格”，是 1980 年代和 1990 年代初人格心理学中最有影响力的发现。

entries.passage: The type of person who goes to a pro wrestling match on the weekend might be a very different kind of person than someone who avoids those kinds of activities. The type of person who studies abroad could be very different from the type of person who doesn’t. Are there distinct personality traits characteristic of the psychologically rich? If so, which of the Big Five factors are associated with a psychologically rich life?
entries.translation: 周末去看职业摔角赛的人，可能与回避此类活动的人很不同。留学的人，也可能与不留学的人很不同。心理丰富的人是否具有独特的人格特质？如果有，哪些大五人格因子与心理丰富的人生相关？

entries.passage: In order to answer these questions, we collected data from over 5,000 respondents in seven separate samples across the U.S., Korea, and India.
entries.translation: 为了回答这些问题，我们从美国、韩国和印度的七个独立样本中，收集了超过 5,000 名受访者的数据。

entries.passage: We asked them a series of questions about a psychologically rich life (e.g., “I have had a lot of interesting experiences,” “On my deathbed, I am likely to say, ‘I have seen and learned a lot’ ”; see Appendix 1 for the full list and find out your own psychological richness score), a series of questions about a happy life (e.g., “I am satisfied with my life,” “So far I have gotten the important things I want in life”), and a series of questions about a meaningful life (e.g., “I have a good sense of what makes my life meaningful,” “My life has a clear sense of purpose”).
entries.translation: 我们向他们提出一系列关于心理丰富人生的问题，例如“我有过许多有趣的经历”“在临终时，我可能会说：我见识并学到了很多”（完整题目见附录 1，也可测测自己的心理丰富性分数）；一系列关于幸福人生的问题，例如“我对自己的人生感到满意”“到目前为止，我已经得到人生中想要的重要东西”；以及一系列关于有意义人生的问题，例如“我很清楚是什么使自己的人生有意义”“我的人生有明确的目的感”。

entries.passage: In addition, we asked about respondents’ personality: the degree to which each word described who they are in general: imaginative, organized, talkative, sympathetic, tense, and so on.
entries.translation: 此外，我们询问受访者的人格：富于想象、做事有条理、健谈、有同情心、紧张等每个词，在多大程度上描述了他们通常的样子。

entries.passage: Two main personality predictors of a psychologically rich life were openness to experiences and extraversion (see Appendix 2 for all the correlations). The .47 correlation between openness to experience and psychological richness is similar to the correlation between heights of fathers and their sons, which is quite strong, though far from absolute. That is, open people tend to lead a psychologically rich life, just like sons whose fathers are tall tend to be tall themselves.
entries.translation: 心理丰富人生的两项主要人格预测因素是经验开放性与外向性（所有相关值见附录 2）。经验开放性与心理丰富性的 .47 相关，类似父亲与儿子身高之间的相关，相当强，但远非绝对。也就是说，开放的人倾向于过心理丰富的人生，就像父亲高的儿子往往也高。

entries.passage: But, just as some sons are very different from their fathers in height, there are also plenty of exceptions: people low in openness who lead psychologically rich lives as well as people who are high in openness who don’t lead psychologically rich lives. For now, let’s focus on the link between openness and psychological richness.
entries.translation: 但正如有些儿子的身高与父亲很不同，这里也有许多例外：有些开放性低的人过着心理丰富的人生，也有些开放性高的人并没有。现在，让我们先聚焦开放性与心理丰富性的联系。

entries.passage: Why do people who are high in openness to experience tend to lead psychologically rich lives? Open people are imaginative, curious, and interested in intellectual and artistic pursuits. People low in openness are conventional and down-to-earth, preferring routine and less interested in intellectual or artistic pursuits. Students who are open to experience are more likely to study abroad, an activity known to enhance psychological richness, than those low in openness.
entries.translation: 为什么经验开放性高的人往往过着心理丰富的人生？开放的人富于想象、好奇，对知识和艺术活动有兴趣。开放性低的人则较传统、脚踏实地，偏好惯例，对知识或艺术活动较少兴趣。与开放性低的学生相比，开放的学生更可能留学；留学是一项已知能增进心理丰富性的活动。

entries.passage: Interestingly, those who studied abroad became more open to experience over time than those who didn’t. Based on this information, we concluded that there is a reciprocal relationship between openness to experience and psychological richness, such that openness to experience increases one’s chance of engaging in richness-enhancing activities, which in turn boosts one’s openness further. Your personality is not your destiny, though; the later chapters of this book are dedicated to strategies that everyone, no matter what your personality is, can implement to make your life more psychologically rich.
entries.translation: 有趣的是，与没有留学的人相比，留学者随时间变得更开放。基于这些信息，我们认为经验开放性与心理丰富性存在双向关系：开放性增加参与增进丰富性活动的机会，而这些活动又进一步提高开放性。不过，人格不是命运；本书后面的章节会介绍每个人无论人格如何，都能采用、使人生更心理丰富的策略。

entries.passage: The .47 correlation also means that having an open personality doesn’t necessarily guarantee that you will lead a psychologically rich life. Joy Ryan, the ninety-four-year-old national park enthusiast we met in Chapter 4, might have always been open to experience. But, until she turned eighty-five, she hadn’t had many opportunities to explore the world. Once she was exposed to Smoky Mountain National Park, she was hooked.
entries.translation: .47 的相关也意味着，拥有开放人格不一定保证过心理丰富的人生。我们在第 4 章见过的九十四岁国家公园爱好者 Joy Ryan，或许一直对经验开放。但是，直到八十五岁前，她都没有太多探索世界的机会。一旦接触 Smoky Mountain National Park，她便着迷了。

entries.passage: She became open to even more new experiences and thereafter wanted to visit all the national parks. In other words, having an open personality plus opportunities and resources opens the door to psychologically rich experiences.
entries.translation: 她对更多新经历变得开放，此后想去游览所有国家公园。换言之，开放的人格加上机会和资源，为心理丰富的经历打开了大门。

entries.passage: Besides opportunities and resources, intellectual and artistic abilities are also factors. Simon Ramo, whose New York Times obituary was rated as particularly psychologically rich, was an aerospace engineer. He earned a PhD in physics and engineering from the California Institute of Technology and later developed intercontinental ballistic missiles, or ICBMs. He published sixty-two books over the course of his life; he had twenty-five patents before he was thirty, and earned his final patent at age one hundred.
entries.translation: 除了机会与资源，智力与艺术能力也是因素。Simon Ramo 是航天工程师，他在《纽约时报》的讣告被评为特别心理丰富。他在 California Institute of Technology 获得物理与工程博士学位，后来研制洲际弹道导弹，即 ICBM。他一生出版六十二本书，三十岁前已有二十五项专利，一百岁取得最后一项专利。

entries.passage: He died at age 103. Simon started out working for large corporations but got sick of the bureaucracy. So he started his own company in a former barbershop, where he developed an initial prototype of an ICBM. He was also interested in other topics, including tennis strategy—he later wrote a book on that, too.
entries.translation: 他于一百零三岁去世。Simon 最初在大公司工作，却厌倦官僚作风。因此他在一间原来的理发店创办自己的公司，在那里开发洲际弹道导弹的初始原型。他也对其他主题有兴趣，包括网球策略——后来他还为此写了一本书。

entries.passage: And he had a great sense of humor. When he was asked about his politics, he replied, “I am a registered opportunist.” Ramo’s fascination with the world could not be codified by a particular belief system. He had diverse interests and an amazing intellect.
entries.translation: 而且，他很有幽默感。被问到政治立场时，他回答：“我是登记在册的机会主义者。”Ramo 对世界的着迷，无法用某个特定信仰体系来归纳。他兴趣多样，智力非凡。

entries.passage: Another example of a person who lived a psychologically rich life is novelist Louis Cha (also known as Jin Yong), whose obituary was featured in the Straits Times. Cha was born in China and started out as a journalist in Shanghai before transferring to his newspaper’s Hong Kong office in the 1950s. He wrote an enormously popular series of novels inspired by martial arts history from 1955 until 1972. Despite his popularity, Cha didn’t write any new novels after this period.
entries.translation: 另一个心理丰富人生的例子是小说家 Louis Cha（亦即 Jin Yong、金庸），他的讣告刊于《海峡时报》。Cha 出生于中国，最初在上海当记者，1950 年代转到报纸的香港办事处。他在 1955 至 1972 年间，写了一系列受武术历史启发、极受欢迎的小说。尽管备受欢迎，这一时期之后他没有再写新小说。

entries.passage: Instead, he reread his own novels and continued to revise them. He would cry while reading his favorite characters’ breakup in his own novel. He was unconventional, even defiant. In the late 1960s he wrote a series of anti-Mao articles, which put Cha on the Chinese Communist Party’s assassination list.
entries.translation: 他转而重读自己的小说，不断修订。在自己的小说里读到最喜爱人物的分手，他会落泪。他不循常规，甚至带有反抗精神。1960 年代末，他写了一系列反毛文章，原文叙述这使他被列入中国共产党的暗杀名单。

entries.passage: He escaped to Singapore and stayed there for almost a year to avoid assassination. Cha’s tumultuous life can hardly be characterized as happy or worry-free. Yet he had a unique, interesting life.
entries.translation: 他逃往新加坡，为避免暗杀在那里住了近一年。Cha 动荡的人生很难说是幸福或无忧无虑的。然而，他拥有独特而有趣的人生。

entries.passage: Personality psychologists have classified openness to experience into two subfactors: openness and intellect. People high in openness tend to have more creative accomplishments in the arts, whereas people high in intellect tend to have more creative accomplishments both in arts and sciences. Simon Ramo must have been high in the intellect dimension of openness to experience, as he explored and found many creative solutions to diverse engineering problems, while Louis Cha must have been high in the openness dimension, as he led an emotionally rich, imaginative life.
entries.translation: 人格心理学家把经验开放性分成两个子因子：开放与智性。开放子因子高的人往往有更多艺术创造成就，而智性高的人在艺术与科学两方面都往往有更多创造成就。作者推断，Simon Ramo 的经验开放性中，智性维度一定很高，因为他探索并创造性解决了各种工程问题；Louis Cha 的开放维度一定很高，因为他过着情感丰富、富于想象的人生。

entries.passage: While the link between openness to experience and psychological richness seems obvious, the role of extraversion in a psychologically rich life might not be. The easiest way to think about the link is to conceive of extraversion as an interest in exploring the social world. That is, if openness to experience is concerned with the exploration of sensory and abstract information, extraversion is concerned with the exploration of interpersonal information. If open people are curious about ideas, extraverts are curious about other people.
entries.translation: 经验开放性与心理丰富性的联系似乎显而易见，外向性在心理丰富人生中的作用却未必如此。理解这联系最容易的方式，是把外向性看作探索社会世界的兴趣。也就是说，如果经验开放性关乎探索感官与抽象信息，外向性就关乎探索人际信息。如果开放的人对观念好奇，外向的人就对其他人好奇。

entries.passage: Because people are different, the more people you interact with, the more diverse experiences you will have and the richer your life becomes.
entries.translation: 由于人各有不同，你与越多人互动，便会有越多样的经历，人生也会变得越丰富。

entries.passage: At a party, who do you talk to? I am an introvert, so I gravitate toward someone I already know. I usually stick with one or two people and try to have a deeper conversation. An extravert has a very different strategy.
entries.translation: 在聚会上，你会和谁交谈？我是内向的人，所以会自然走向自己已经认识的人。我通常和一两个人待在一起，试着作较深入的交谈。外向的人则有很不同的策略。

entries.passage: They talk to many new people and make more friends. Extraverts become friends with other extraverts, a phenomenon called the “network extraversion bias.” Since extraverts have more friends than introverts, making an extraverted friend is likely to expand your social networks more than making an introverted friend. In the long run, then, extraverts are more likely to meet different kinds of people and are more likely to learn new things than an introvert like myself.
entries.translation: 他们会与许多新面孔交谈，交到更多朋友。外向者会与其他外向者成为朋友，这一现象称为“社交网络外向性偏向”。由于外向者比内向者朋友更多，与外向者交朋友，可能比与内向者交朋友更能扩展你的社交网络。因此从长远看，外向者比像我这样的内向者，更可能遇到不同类型的人，也更可能学到新东西。

entries.passage: This is one way that extraversion is linked to a psychologically rich life.
entries.translation: 这是外向性与心理丰富人生发生联系的一种方式。

entries.passage: On a basic level, why do extraverts explore the social world more? One factor is their confidence and self-assurance. When you are confident, meeting a new person is not threatening. What is there to lose?
entries.translation: 从基本层面说，外向者为什么更多探索社交世界？一个因素是他们的自信与自我确信。自信时，结识新朋友并不令人感到威胁。有什么可失去的呢？

entries.passage: You are not worried about being negatively evaluated by this person or making a bad impression. Instead, you are thinking about the benefits: getting to know someone new, learning something new, sharing interesting stories. There is a positive spiral here, too. The more confident you are, the more likely you are to enter a new conversation.
entries.translation: 你不担心对方负面评价自己，或给人留下坏印象。相反，你想到的是收益：结识新人、学到新东西、分享有趣的故事。这里也存在一种正向循环。你越自信，就越可能加入新的谈话。

entries.passage: The more new conversations you enter, the psychologically richer the party becomes for you. Someone who has a psychologically enriching experience at one party is more likely to go to another party.
entries.translation: 你加入的新谈话越多，这场聚会对你而言就越心理丰富。在一次聚会上获得使心理更丰富的经历的人，更可能参加另一场聚会。

entries.passage: Another aspect of extraversion that might be related to psychological richness is energy. Extraverts tend to be more energetic than introverts. The more energy one has, the more activities one can engage in. One study, for instance, found that extraverts were involved with more college activities, such as intramural athletics, campus clubs, and service and volunteer clubs, than introverts.
entries.translation: 外向性中另一个可能与心理丰富性相关的方面是精力。外向者往往比内向者更有精力。一个人精力越多，就能参与越多活动。例如，一项研究发现，外向者比内向者参与更多大学活动，包括校内体育、校园社团，以及服务和志愿者组织。

entries.passage: Joy Ryan is again a great example here. Compared to other ninety-somethings, she is full of energy. Thanks to this, she can visit remote national parks and enjoy unusual, psychologically rich experiences.
entries.translation: Joy Ryan 在这里又是一个很好的例子。与其他九十多岁的人相比，她精力充沛。正因如此，她能游览偏远的国家公园，享受不同寻常、心理丰富的经历。

entries.passage: Is a happy person different from a psychologically rich person? One example of a “happy” person is Mr. Rogers in Mister Rogers’ Neighborhood. In this show, he is a friendly neighbor with a cheerful smile. The show consists of lots of singing, dancing, and puppet shows.
entries.translation: 幸福的人与心理丰富的人是否不同？Mister Rogers’ Neighborhood 中的 Mr. Rogers，是一个“幸福”人物的例子。在这档节目里，他是面带愉快笑容的友善邻居。节目包括许多歌唱、舞蹈和木偶戏。

entries.passage: That’s a lot of fun! Who wouldn’t want to hang out with a guy who sings, “Please, won’t you be my neighbor?”
entries.translation: 这可真有趣！谁不想和一个唱着“请问，你愿意做我的邻居吗？”的人一起相处呢？

entries.passage: Mr. Rogers demonstrates the essential characteristics of happy people: extraverted, emotionally stable (lacking neuroticism), conscientious, and agreeable. The patterns of correlation for psychological richness are quite different from those for happiness. According to Anglim and colleagues’ meta-analysis, a happy life is characterized by emotional stability, extraversion, conscientiousness, and agreeableness, but not by openness to experiences.
entries.translation: Mr. Rogers 展现了幸福者的核心特征：外向、情绪稳定（较少神经质）、尽责、宜人。心理丰富性的相关模式，与幸福的模式相当不同。据 Anglim 及同事的元分析，幸福人生以情绪稳定、外向、尽责和宜人为特征，却不以经验开放性为特征。

entries.passage: The two strongest personality predictors of a happy life are emotional stability and extraversion. Some personality scholars conceptualize extraversion as positive affectivity (good moods) and neuroticism as negative affectivity (bad moods). Since by definition a happy life is the preponderance of positive emotions and relative lack of negative emotions, it makes sense that extraversion and emotional stability are the most characteristic of a happy life.
entries.translation: 幸福人生的两项最强人格预测因素是情绪稳定性与外向性。一些人格学者把外向性理解为积极情感倾向（好心情），把神经质理解为消极情感倾向（坏心情）。按定义，幸福人生是积极情绪占优势、消极情绪相对较少；因此，外向与情绪稳定最能体现幸福人生，是合乎道理的。

entries.passage: Overall, the key difference between a happy personality and a psychologically rich personality is that happy people are not necessarily open to experiences, whereas psychologically rich people are quite open. This means that there are almost as many people who, like travel writer Rick Steves, are happy and open to experience as there are people who, like chef and travel documentarian Anthony Bourdain, are less happy but open to experience.
entries.translation: 总体而言，幸福人格与心理丰富人格的关键区别是：幸福者不一定对经验开放，而心理丰富者相当开放。作者说，这意味着，像旅行作家 Rick Steves 一样既幸福又开放的人，与像厨师兼旅行纪录片制作者 Anthony Bourdain 一样较不幸福但开放的人，数量几乎相当。

entries.passage: Why are emotional stability, extraversion, conscientiousness, and agreeableness good for a happy life? Primarily because the quality of social relationships is a big predictor of happiness. Who has good social relationships? Well, someone like Mr. Rogers: friendly, stable, reliable, and kind.
entries.translation: 为什么情绪稳定、外向、尽责与宜人有利于幸福人生？主要因为社交关系的质量是幸福的重要预测因素。谁拥有良好的社交关系？像 Mr. Rogers 这样的人：友善、稳定、可靠而善良。

entries.passage: Someone who is emotionally volatile, introverted, unreliable, and argumentative doesn’t win many friends.
entries.translation: 一个情绪起伏不定、内向、不可靠且爱争辩的人，不容易赢得很多朋友。

entries.passage: Second, financial stability and relationship stability are important for a happy life. In order to achieve these, we must work hard on our finances and our relationships. We need to remember the deadlines of various tasks and the birthdays of children and in-laws. We need to do some things that we don’t want to do.
entries.translation: 第二，财务稳定与关系稳定对幸福人生很重要。为了做到这些，我们必须在财务和人际关系上付出努力。我们需要记住各种任务的截止日期，以及孩子和姻亲的生日。我们也需要做一些自己不想做的事情。

entries.passage: So, conscientiousness does help. Agreeableness improves work relationships as well as family relationships. If your boss likes you, you are more likely to receive a raise or a promotion than if they don’t like you.
entries.translation: 因此，尽责性确实有帮助。宜人性既能改善工作关系，也能改善家庭关系。如果上司喜欢你，你得到加薪或晋升的可能性，比上司不喜欢你时更高。

entries.passage: Third, the positivity associated with extraversion is helpful when we face difficult life circumstances. Emotional stability will help us recover from negative news more quickly. Bad things happen to good people. But when they do, extraversion and emotional stability are a boon (and our psychological immune system is there to help either way).
entries.translation: 第三，外向性所关联的积极性，有助于应对困难处境。情绪稳定性帮助我们更快从坏消息中恢复。好人也会遇到坏事。但坏事发生时，外向性与情绪稳定性是一种助益（无论如何，我们的心理免疫系统也会提供帮助）。

entries.passage: Finally, why is openness to experience uncorrelated to a happy life? One potential reason is the greater motivation to explore among open people. When an exploration (e.g., trying out a new restaurant) results in a positive outcome, it is associated with higher levels of happiness. But when the exploration results in a negative experience, it is not.
entries.translation: 最后，为什么经验开放性与幸福人生不相关？一个可能原因是开放者更有探索动机。当探索（例如尝试一家新餐厅）带来正面结果时，它与更高幸福水平相联。但探索带来负面经历时，则并非如此。

entries.passage: Exploration is also antithetical to the stability that is the foundation for a happy life.
entries.translation: 探索也与稳定相对立，而稳定是幸福人生的基础。

entries.passage: Now let’s think about the type of people who lead a meaningful life. Greta Thunberg, the Swedish environmental activist, comes to mind. At the opposite end of the political spectrum, Mike Huckabee also comes to mind. What do their personalities have in common?
entries.translation: 现在来想想过着有意义人生的人是什么样。瑞典环保活动者 Greta Thunberg 令人想到。在政治光谱的另一端，Mike Huckabee 也令人想到。他们的人格有什么共同之处？

entries.passage: At age fifteen, Greta began protesting in front of the Swedish parliament every Friday with a sign that read, “School Strike for Climate.” Her movement, dubbed “Fridays for Future,” spread around the world. She catalyzed a host of youth climate activism, and to date continues to advocate for reducing carbon emissions and increasing sustainability. Greta is endlessly committed to her work.
entries.translation: 十五岁时，Greta 开始每周五站在瑞典议会前抗议，举着写有“为气候罢课”的牌子。她的运动被称为“Fridays for Future”，传播到世界各地。她推动了大量青年气候行动；截至原书叙述时，她仍倡导减少碳排放、提高可持续性。Greta 始终投入自己的工作。

entries.passage: In 2019, she even took a sabbatical from school to dedicate all her energy to activism. She prioritizes her environmental activism work over other commitments and works relentlessly. A woman of conviction.
entries.translation: 2019 年，她甚至暂时离校，把全部精力投入行动。她把环保行动工作置于其他事务之上，不懈努力。一个拥有坚定信念的女人。

entries.passage: Mike Huckabee was born in Arkansas. He studied religion in college, then became a staffer for televangelist James Robison, then a pastor in Texarkana. As a pastor, he listened to so many personal stories of struggles that were policy-related that he turned to politics and became the governor of Arkansas.
entries.translation: Mike Huckabee 出生于 Arkansas。他在大学学习宗教，之后成为电视布道者 James Robison 的工作人员，随后在 Texarkana 当牧师。做牧师时，他听到太多与政策有关的个人困境故事，因此转向政治，后来成为 Arkansas 州长。

entries.passage: He thinks about policy issues from the perspective of his religious beliefs (e.g., he is a believer in forgiveness, therefore supports a generous policy regarding clemencies) and he uses food metaphors frequently (e.g., on whether the U.S. should accept Syrian refugees, he said, “If you bought a 5 lb. bag of peanuts and you knew that in the 5 lb. bag of peanuts there were about 10 peanuts that were deadly poisonous, would you feed them to your kids? The answer is no”).
entries.translation: 他从宗教信念的视角思考政策议题（例如，他信奉宽恕，因此支持较宽松的赦免政策），而且经常使用食物比喻（例如，谈到美国是否应接受叙利亚难民，他说：“如果你买了一袋五磅的花生，知道袋中约十颗有致命毒性，你会拿给孩子吃吗？答案是不会。”）。注：这是书中归于 Huckabee 的假设类比，不是关于难民实际风险的研究数据或网站立场。

entries.passage: He probably thinks his life is meaningful because he has dedicated his life to religious causes, he has made differences in others’ lives, and his life has been guided by clear principles. A man of conviction.
entries.translation: 他大概认为自己的人生有意义，因为他一生投入宗教事业，对他人的生活产生了影响，而且人生由明确原则指引。一个拥有坚定信念的男人。

entries.passage: There are numerous paths to achieving a meaningful life, but personality research has shown that people who lead a meaningful life are characterized first by conscientiousness, followed by emotional stability, extraversion, agreeableness, and, as with happy people, least by openness to experience.
entries.translation: 通往有意义人生的道路很多，但人格研究显示，过着有意义人生的人，首先以尽责性为特征，其后依次是情绪稳定性、外向性、宜人性；与幸福者一样，最不以经验开放性为特征。

entries.passage: Conscientious people are well organized, careful, and thorough. They have clear goals and pursue them diligently. It follows that, in order to pursue your goals successfully, you can’t worry too much about various barriers to success or get discouraged too easily when things don’t go well. Thus, lower levels of neuroticism (not worrying too much) are helpful.
entries.translation: 尽责的人有条理、细心而周密。他们有明确目标，并勤奋追求。因此，为成功追求目标，你不能过分担忧成功路上的种种障碍，也不能事情不顺时就轻易灰心。所以，较低的神经质水平（不过分担心）是有帮助的。

entries.passage: It is interesting to note that Greta Thunberg appears more neurotic than most. She worries intensely about environmental disasters and climate change. However, she seems to leverage her anxiety to fuel her work. So long as one’s neuroticism is not overwhelming, a meaningful life is possible.
entries.translation: 值得注意的是，Thunberg 似乎比多数人更具神经质倾向。她强烈担忧环境灾难和气候变化。然而，她似乎把焦虑转化为工作的动力。只要神经质倾向没有强到令人无法承受，有意义的人生仍然可能。

entries.passage: In contrast, openness is difficult for those who have strong convictions. It’s easy to become self-righteous about your causes. Mike Huckabee is unlikely to be open to immigration from Muslim countries because of his conviction that a small minority could be terrorists. Greta Thunberg is unlikely to be open to climate change deniers’ opinions, as she is convinced that climate change is driven by human activities.
entries.translation: 相比之下，信念坚定的人可能难以保持开放。人很容易对自己的事业自以为正义。作者认为，Huckabee 不太可能对来自穆斯林国家的移民开放，因为他坚信其中少数人可能是恐怖分子；Thunberg 不太可能接纳气候变化否认者的意见，因为她确信气候变化由人类活动驱动。这里保留作者的人物信念归属，不把前一说法当作关于实际群体风险的研究结论。

entries.passage: So, who is likely to lead a psychologically rich life? In terms of personality traits, people who are open to experience and extraverted are most likely to lead a psychologically rich life. They are more likely to do something new, meet someone new, or learn something new, like Goldmund in Narcissus and Goldmund. These relationships are not deterministic, however.
entries.translation: 那么，谁可能过心理丰富的人生？从人格特质看，经验开放且外向的人最可能如此。他们更可能做新事、遇见新人或学到新东西，像 Narcissus and Goldmund 中的 Goldmund。不过，这些关系并非决定性的。

entries.passage: There are plenty of introverts who lead a psychologically rich life. The type of intellectual journey that Alison Gopnik had is available to introverts who seek new intellectual knowledge. Likewise, Joy Ryan went to so many national parks with her grandson Brad. Led by someone like Brad, introverted people might do something unusual.
entries.translation: 有许多内向者过着心理丰富的人生。对寻求新知识的内向者，Alison Gopnik 那种思想探索之旅同样可行。同样，Joy Ryan 和孙子 Brad 去了许多国家公园。有像 Brad 那样的人引领，内向者也可能做不同寻常的事。

entries.passage: It should be noted that conscientiousness, agreeableness, and emotional stability are secondarily predictors of a rich life. That means that you can set a goal to be open to new experiences and conscientiously work on that goal and lead a psychologically rich life. You can be agreeable to your friend’s and partner’s suggestions for a new adventure and expand your horizons. There really are numerous ways to lead a psychologically rich life.
entries.translation: 还应注意，尽责性、宜人性和情绪稳定性也是丰富人生的次要预测因素。这意味着，你可设定对新经历开放的目标，认真努力追求它，过心理丰富的人生。你也可以接纳朋友和伴侣提出的新冒险建议，拓展眼界。过心理丰富人生的方式确实很多。

entries.passage: Who is happy? Extraverts and emotionally stable people tend to lead a happy life perhaps in part because they tend to have good relationships and find something positive in most situations. Conscientious people tend to be happy as well, perhaps because they tend to achieve their goals, whereas agreeable people tend to be happy in part because they have warm, conflict-free relationships with others.
entries.translation: 谁幸福？外向且情绪稳定的人往往过幸福人生，或许部分因为他们往往拥有好关系，也能在多数处境中发现积极之处。尽责者也往往幸福，或许因为他们往往实现目标；宜人者往往幸福，部分因为他们与他人拥有温暖、少冲突的关系。

entries.passage: Finally, who leads a meaningful life? Conscientious and emotionally stable people tend to do so in part because they can devote themselves to a few causes for an extended period of time without worrying too much, and in the end make a difference in the world.
entries.translation: 最后，谁过有意义的人生？尽责且情绪稳定的人往往如此，部分因为他们可以不过度担忧，长期投入少数几项事业，最终对世界产生影响。

entries.passage: In short, openness to experiences represents the most striking difference between the personality correlates of a psychologically rich life and those of a happy and meaningful life. Whereas openness to experience plays a relatively minor role in happiness and meaning, it plays a major role in a psychologically rich life. Personality research on psychological richness reveals that there is a path to a good life via being open to new experiences.
entries.translation: 总之，在心理丰富人生与幸福、有意义人生的人格相关因素之间，经验开放性构成最显著的区别。它对幸福和意义的作用相对较小，对心理丰富人生却作用重大。关于心理丰富性的人格研究显示，接纳新经历是通往美好人生的一条道路。

entries.passage: A lesson from personality psychology, then, is that it is important to know who you are (you can take a Big Five personality test on my website!). It is also important to know which personality traits are associated with each dimension of a good life. Harness this understanding of our personality and the personality traits associated with psychological richness, happiness, and meaning to develop strategies for achieving the good life.
entries.translation: 那么，人格心理学的一项启示是：了解自己是谁很重要（你可以在作者的网站上做大五人格测试）。了解哪些人格特质与美好人生的各维度相关，也同样重要。利用对自身人格以及与心理丰富、幸福、意义相关特质的理解，制定实现美好人生的策略。

entries.passage: The following chapters give some tips for how we all can incorporate a bit of psychological richness into our everyday lives. Even if you are neurotic, disagreeable, unconscientious, introverted, and closed to new experiences, personality can change with effort. Don’t give up. Keep on reading!
entries.translation: 接下来的章节会给出一些方法，让我们都能把一点心理丰富性融入日常生活。即使你神经质倾向较高、不宜人、不尽责、内向、对新经历不开放，人格也可以随着努力而改变。不要放弃。继续读下去！

entries.passage: At the core of a psychologically rich personality are openness to experience and extraversion. One might ask, though: How can those of us who don’t have those basic personality traits become more open and extraverted? One answer is to embrace playfulness. In a 1980 study, when Robert McCrae and Paul Costa asked 240 men to complete various sentences such as, “What gets me into trouble is…” and “When his wife asked him to do the housework…,” open-minded men’s responses were far more playful than closed-minded men’s responses.
entries.translation: 心理丰富人格的核心是经验开放性与外向性。但有人或许会问：缺少这些基本特质的我们，怎样变得更开放、更外向？一种回答是拥抱玩心。1980 年的一项研究中，Robert McCrae 与 Paul Costa 请 240 名男性补全“让我惹上麻烦的是……”和“当妻子请他做家务时……”等句子；开放男性的回答比不开放男性的回答俏皮得多。

entries.passage: For instance, a man high in openness to experience said, “When my wife asked me to do the housework, I invented an urgent excuse.” A closed-minded man would have responded, “When my wife asked me to do the housework, I reluctantly did.” McCrae and Costa observed, “The final distinguishing characteristic of open men is a playful, sometimes odd, sense of humor. A slight twist may be given to meanings, and obviously playful objections to the test are frequently made.”
entries.translation: 例如，一位高经验开放性的男性说：“当妻子请我做家务时，我编了个紧急借口。”不开放的男性则会这样回答：“当妻子请我做家务时，我勉强做了。”这里原文对后者使用条件语气。McCrae 与 Costa 观察道：“开放男性最后一个区分性特征，是俏皮、有时古怪的幽默感。他们可能稍稍扭转意思，也常对测试提出明显带玩笑性质的异议。”

entries.passage: So, playfulness, quirkiness, and lightheartedness may be central to both openness and psychological richness.
entries.translation: 因此，玩心、古怪趣味和轻松态度，可能对开放性与心理丰富性都很重要。

entries.passage: But what exactly is being playful? The psychoanalyst Erik Erikson described it best: when you are playful, you are “on vacation from social and economic reality.” All of us adults have a lot of social and economic responsibilities. That is the reality.
entries.translation: 但究竟什么叫有玩心？精神分析学家 Erik Erikson 的描述最贴切：有玩心时，你仿佛“从社会和经济现实中休假”。我们成年人都有许多社会与经济责任。这就是现实。

entries.passage: But Erikson encourages us to go somewhere between fantasy and actuality once in a while. Free yourself from duties and responsibilities. Play basketball and imitate Steph Curry. Watch a movie and pretend to be like Roger Ebert.
entries.translation: 不过，Erikson 鼓励我们偶尔走到幻想与现实之间。让自己暂时从责任与义务中松开。打篮球时模仿 Steph Curry；看电影时假装自己像 Roger Ebert。

entries.passage: Watch the evening news and impersonate the president. Sing along with Beyoncé.
entries.translation: 看晚间新闻时，模仿总统。跟着 Beyoncé 一起唱歌。

entries.passage: The importance of playfulness is most noticeable during events when there is a lot at stake. For instance, the Olympics. Michael Phelps won thirteen Olympic gold medals in individual events and is widely considered one of the best swimmers of all time. He was already training at eight years old and breaking all kinds of age group records.
entries.translation: 玩心的重要性，在得失重大的场合尤其明显，例如奥运会。Michael Phelps 在奥运个人项目中赢得十三枚金牌，广被认为是史上最优秀的游泳运动员之一。他八岁便已训练，打破各种年龄组纪录。

entries.passage: Phelps continued to train hard under coach Bob Bowman from age eleven on. His older sister Hilary was an Olympic-level swimmer as well. He grew up soaked in the world of competitive swimming. Phelps swam about six hours a day for six days a week.
entries.translation: Phelps 从十一岁起继续在教练 Bob Bowman 指导下刻苦训练。姐姐 Hilary 也是奥运水平的游泳运动员。他在竞技游泳的世界中成长，深深浸润其中。他每周游六天，每天约六小时。

entries.passage: He also lifted weights and stretched. Michael Phelps is supremely talented and full of grit.
entries.translation: 他也举重和拉伸。Michael Phelps 天赋极高，而且充满坚毅。

entries.passage: Simone Biles is another extraordinary athlete. She won gold medals in the all-around, vault, and floor events at 2016 Rio Olympics. Overall, she has won more Olympic medals than any other American gymnast. Like Phelps, Biles started training seriously at age eight.
entries.translation: Simone Biles 是另一位非凡运动员。她在 2016 里约奥运的全能、跳马和自由体操项目赢得金牌。书中称，截至其叙述时，她赢得的奥运奖牌多于任何其他美国体操运动员。和 Phelps 一样，Biles 八岁开始认真训练。

entries.passage: She has enormous talent. Simone was homeschooled so that she could train twenty to thirty-two hours per week. She demonstrated unparalleled devotion to gymnastics.
entries.translation: 她天赋极高。Simone 接受居家教育，以便每周训练二十至三十二小时。她对体操展现了非凡的投入。

entries.passage: In addition to grueling training, very small details are crucial in both swimming and gymnastics. In swimming, a win or loss is literally a matter of a split second. In gymnastics, any fall or the slightest loss of balance could ruin your performance. In other words, they are extremely high-pressure sports.
entries.translation: 除了艰苦训练，很小的细节对游泳与体操都至关重要。游泳胜负确实取决于分秒之间。体操中，任何跌落或最轻微的失衡，都可能毁掉表现。换句话说，这些运动压力极大。

entries.passage: A tiny mistake could cost you a medal. Moreover, the Olympic Games take place every four years, so the preparation period is extremely long. A moment can rob you of your dream and a decade of dedication. Despite achieving spectacular success, both Michael Phelps and Simone Biles suffered from anxiety and depression.
entries.translation: 一个小失误可能让你失去奖牌。而且，奥运会每四年举行一次，准备周期极长。一个瞬间就可能夺走梦想与十年的投入。尽管成就非凡，书中叙述 Michael Phelps 与 Simone Biles 都曾经历焦虑和抑郁。

entries.passage: They lost interest in the sports in which they excelled. Single-minded dedication is surely admirable, even virtuous. But, too much single-mindedness could rob you of the simple joy of just being able to jump, run, or swim.
entries.translation: 他们对自己最擅长的运动失去了兴趣。专心一意地投入当然值得钦佩，甚至可称为美德。但是，过度专注可能夺走仅仅能够跳跃、奔跑或游泳的简单快乐。

entries.passage: In the world of elite athletes, practice, practice, and more practice is the name of the game. There is not much space for playfulness. Yet play and playfulness are critical for healthy child development. Alison Gopnik argues that humans have an extraordinarily long childhood, during which they can try out many things before they are forced to specialize in one area as adults.
entries.translation: 在精英运动员的世界里，训练、训练、再训练才是核心，几乎没有多少玩心的空间。然而，玩耍与玩心对儿童健康发展至关重要。Alison Gopnik 认为，人类拥有格外漫长的童年，可以先尝试许多事，之后才在成年时被迫专攻一个领域。

entries.passage: This prolonged period of exploration is a time of play, which is crucial for learning social norms and diverse skills in informal settings.
entries.translation: 这段延长的探索期，是玩耍的时期；它对在非正式环境中学习社会规范和多样技能至关重要。

entries.passage: A recent study examined whether higher performance would be achieved through single-minded dedication to one main sport or playing multiple sports before specializing in one sport.
entries.translation: 一项近期研究考察，更高表现究竟来自专心投入一项主运动，还是先参与多项运动、之后再专攻一种。这里的“近期”依原书叙述时点理解。

entries.passage: This study meta-analyzed fifty-five studies that included 6,096 athletes, including 772 of the world’s top performers (defined as top ten performers in an international competition such as the Olympics, World Athletics Championships, or Pan American Games), 3,028 national class performers (members of a national selection team or squad, or placed in the top ten at national championships), 1,706 regional class athletes (minor-league baseball, NCAA Division I), and 590 local or county-level athletes.
entries.translation: 这项研究对五十五项研究作元分析，共含 6,096 名运动员：772 名世界顶级选手（定义为奥运、世界田径锦标赛或泛美运动会等国际比赛前十名）、3,028 名全国级选手（国家选拔队成员，或全国锦标赛前十）、1,706 名区域级选手（棒球小联盟、NCAA 一级），以及 590 名地方或县级运动员。

entries.passage: The researchers found that elite athletes who played multiple sports until later in life were less likely to burn out and more likely to succeed in national and international competitions in adulthood than elite athletes who started specializing early in their career. For every Michael Phelps and Simone Biles, there are athletes like Michael Jordan and Alex Morgan. Michael Jordan played baseball and football as well as basketball in high school.
entries.translation: 研究者发现，相较于职业生涯很早便专攻的精英选手，较晚之前仍参与多项运动的选手，更少倦怠，也更可能在成年全国及国际比赛成功。每有像 Michael Phelps 和 Simone Biles 的选手，也有像 Michael Jordan 和 Alex Morgan 的选手。Jordan 高中时除了篮球，还打棒球和美式橄榄球。

entries.passage: While he was mourning his father, he took a sabbatical from basketball for two years in his prime and played baseball. Alex Morgan grew up playing multiple sports and didn’t play in a club team until age fourteen. She played volleyball and ran track as well as played soccer in high school.
entries.translation: 哀悼父亲期间，Jordan 在巅峰期暂离篮球两年，改打棒球。Alex Morgan 从小参与多项运动，直到十四岁才参加俱乐部队。高中时，她除了踢足球，还打排球、参加田径。

entries.passage: Another key finding from this study is that the success rate at the junior competition level is predicted by the earlier start age (the earlier, the more success), whereas the success rate at the adult competition level is predicted by the later start age. That is, in adult elite competition, the athletes who started the sport later in their lives were more successful than those who started early.
entries.translation: 研究另一个关键发现是：青少年比赛的成功率由较早开始年龄预测（越早越成功），而成年比赛的成功率由较晚开始年龄预测。也就是说，在成年精英比赛中，较晚开始该运动的选手，比早开始者更成功。

entries.passage: Relatedly, world-class athletes reached a major milestone (e.g., first participation in a national championship, first nomination for a selection team/squad) significantly later than did their national-class counterparts.
entries.translation: 与此相关，世界级选手达到重要里程碑（例如首次参加全国锦标赛、首次入选选拔队伍）的时间，显著晚于全国级的对应选手。

entries.passage: In the short term, specialization translates to success. In the long term, however, it doesn’t always pay off. Indeed, this study found that a higher amount of youth-led play (e.g., pickup games) outside of an athlete’s primary sport was associated with higher performance among adult players. Surprisingly, a high number of main-sport practice hours was associated with lower performance among the world-class adult athletes.
entries.translation: 短期内，专攻会转化为成功；但长期看，并不总有回报。研究发现，在主运动之外，更多青少年自主玩耍（如临时自组比赛）与较高成年表现相关。令人意外的是，世界级成年运动员中，大量主项训练时数反而与较低表现相关。

entries.passage: These findings, combined with the findings on youth-led play in other sports, suggest that if you are an elite athlete, it is better to increase playful engagement in other sports and reduce coach-led practice time for your main sport.
entries.translation: 这些发现与其他运动中青少年自主玩耍的发现结合，提示作者：如果你是精英运动员，增加其他运动中的玩乐参与、减少主运动的教练主导训练，可能更好。

entries.passage: Intriguingly, the early specialization effect was replicated in a completely different professional domain: science. Another study compared forty-eight German Nobel laureates in physics, chemistry, economics, and medicine/physiology with the winners of the Leibniz Prize, which is Germany’s highest national science award. Forty-two of the forty-eight Nobel laureates had engaged in multidisciplinary study or work experiences, suggesting a later specialization. The Leibniz Prize winners who did not win the Nobel Prize had earlier success than those who went on to be Nobel winners.
entries.translation: 有趣的是，早期专攻效应在完全不同的专业领域——科学——也得到重复观察。另一项研究，把物理、化学、经济学及医学／生理学领域的四十八位德国诺贝尔奖得主，与德国最高国家科学奖 Leibniz 奖得主比较。四十八位中四十二位有跨学科学习或工作经历，提示较晚专攻。未获诺奖的 Leibniz 得主，早期成功来得比后来获诺奖者更早。

entries.passage: For instance, Leibniz winners were more likely to have won a scholarship as students than Nobel laureates. My favorite finding: it took significantly longer for the eventual Nobel winners to earn full professorships than the Leibniz winners. So, Nobel laureates explored more diverse areas of study and made slower progress than Leibniz winners, but eventually reached the top without burning out.
entries.translation: 例如，Leibniz 得主比诺奖得主更可能在学生时代获得奖学金。我最喜欢的发现是：后来获诺奖者成为正教授的时间，显著长于 Leibniz 得主。因此，作者概括，诺奖得主探索更多学科、进展较慢，却最终到达顶峰而未耗尽热情。

entries.passage: In the essay “Human, All Too Human” in his work Ecce Homo, Friedrich Nietzsche wrote about German specialization as follows: “I have discovered that a large number of young men experience the same distress: one antinatural step virtually compels the second. In Germany, the Reich—to speak unambiguously—all too many are condemned to choose vocations too early, and then to waste away under a burden they can no longer shake off.
entries.translation: 在 Ecce Homo 中题为“Human, All Too Human”的文章里，Friedrich Nietzsche 谈德国的专攻现象：“我发现，许多年轻人经历着同样的苦恼：一个违背自然的步骤，几乎迫使他们走向第二步。在德国，在这个帝国里——说得明确些——太多人注定过早选择职业，之后在再也甩不掉的负担下衰耗。”这是文学／哲学引语，不是实验结果。

entries.passage: These people require Wagner as an opium: they forget themselves, they are rid of themselves for a moment—what am I saying? For five or six hours!”
entries.translation: “这些人需要 Wagner 作为一种鸦片：他们忘了自己，一时摆脱自己——我在说什么？是五六个小时！”这里的“鸦片”是引语中的比喻，表现暂时忘我。

entries.passage: The story of William James Sidis presents another cautionary tale. He is often considered the smartest man to have ever lived. At age eight, he passed the Harvard Medical School’s anatomy exam, as well as the entrance exam to MIT. When Sidis was eleven years old, he gave a lecture on astrophysics at Harvard.
entries.translation: William James Sidis 的故事又是一个警示事例。他常被认为是史上最聪明的人。八岁时，他通过 Harvard Medical School 的解剖学考试，也通过 MIT 入学考试。十一岁时，他在 Harvard 作天体物理讲座。

entries.passage: An MIT physics professor in attendance remarked that Sidis would be a great astronomical mathematician and a scientific leader. But the professor’s prediction was wrong. Sidis burned out. Early specialization might dispel interest in other activities in life and could lead to early burnout.
entries.translation: 在场的一位 MIT 物理教授说，Sidis 将成为伟大的天文数学家与科学领袖。但教授的预测错了。Sidis 耗尽了热情。过早专攻，可能使人对生活中其他活动的兴趣消退，也可能导致早期倦怠。

entries.passage: The high prevalence of burnout and depression among elite athletes and academics makes me wonder if a singular grit needs to be paired with playfulness.
entries.translation: 精英运动员与学者中，倦怠与抑郁较为常见，这让我思考：只盯单一目标的坚毅，是否需要与玩心相伴？

entries.passage: The Major League Baseball season is long and grueling, consisting of 33 spring training games, 162 regular season games, and up to 22 postseason games—a total of 217 games! This schedule is especially demanding for Shohei Ohtani of the Dodgers, as he hits in most games and pitches at least once a week. He has grit and confidence. But he also has playfulness.
entries.translation: 原书描述，MLB 赛季漫长而艰苦，包括 33 场春训赛、162 场常规赛，以及最多 22 场季后赛——所列上限合计 217 场！这安排对 Dodgers 的 Shohei Ohtani 尤其吃力，书中说他多数比赛打击，至少每周投球一次。他有坚毅与自信，也有玩心。

entries.passage: Ohtani had a terrible start to the 2022 season as a hitter, going 3 for 24 (.125). A stat like this might make a baseball player feel depressed. But during one game, after he failed to get a hit again and was making his way back to the dugout, Ohtani jokingly gave his bat CPR. His sense of humor in the face of difficulty appears to help Ohtani relax and perform at an elite level consistently.
entries.translation: Ohtani 在 2022 赛季打击开局糟糕，24 次中有 3 次安打（.125）。这样的数据可能使球员沮丧。但某场比赛中，他又未击出安打、走回球员席时，开玩笑地给球棒做了 CPR。他面对困难的幽默感，似乎有助放松并持续保持顶级表现。

entries.passage: As MLB becomes increasingly dominated by data analytics, the game is becoming more and more logical; it is turning into more of a chess game than a “national pastime.” Lightheartedness punctures the monotony and puts fun back into work.
entries.translation: 随着 MLB 越来越由数据分析主导，比赛变得越来越逻辑化；它愈发像棋局，而不像“国民消遣”。轻松态度打破单调，把趣味重新带回工作。

entries.passage: Shaquille O’Neal is another elite athlete who was feared as well as loved as a player. Unlike his teammate Kobe Bryant, who was known for his grueling work ethic, Shaq was known for not working as hard. In an interview with Patrick Bet-David, Shaq said, “Kobe was a beast, nobody works harder than him…. See, Kobe was just getting married and getting into his family, I’m already four kids in.
entries.translation: Shaquille O’Neal 是另一位顶级运动员，作为球员既令人敬畏，也受人喜爱。与以艰苦训练精神著称的队友 Kobe Bryant 不同，Shaq 被认为没那么刻苦。在 Patrick Bet-David 的采访中，他说：“Kobe 太猛了，没有人比他更努力……那时 Kobe 刚结婚、开始进入家庭生活，而我已是四个孩子的父亲。”

entries.passage: So after I put my two to three hours of work, now I have to be Daddy, now I have to be husband, now I have to take care of business.” In many ways, Shaq was more relaxed, lighthearted, and whimsical. He continued in the interview, “I think you can find success in many ways.” Shohei and Shaq are both plenty successful.
entries.translation: “所以，完成两到三小时的工作后，我还要当爸爸、当丈夫，还要处理商业事务。”在许多方面，Shaq 更放松、轻松而随兴。他在采访中接着说：“我认为成功可以有很多方式。”Shohei 和 Shaq 都相当成功。

entries.passage: Ohtani was the American League Rookie of the Year in 2018 and the MVP in 2021 and 2023. Shaq was the Rookie of the Year in 1993 and the MVP in 2000, and won four NBA championships. If Shaq had Kobe’s work ethic, Shaq might have accomplished even more as a basketball player. But he also might have burned out early in his career.
entries.translation: 原书列出，Ohtani 是 2018 年美联年度新人、2021 与 2023 年 MVP；Shaq 是 1993 年年度新人、2000 年 MVP，赢得四次 NBA 冠军。如果 Shaq 有 Kobe 的敬业精神，他可能在篮球上取得更多成就。但他也可能在生涯更早阶段就倦怠。

entries.passage: Work ethic is well known to be critical to rising in professional sports and competitive professions. Even so, playfulness might be an underrated contributor to long-term success.
entries.translation: 众所周知，敬业精神对在职业体育及竞争性职业中上升至关重要。即便如此，玩心可能是一个被低估的长期成功因素。

entries.passage: Is there any empirical evidence that suggests playfulness is actually good? Swiss psychologist René Proyer has studied adult playfulness more intensely than anyone I know. He found that playfulness is a blend of openness to experience and extraversion, and a relative lack of conscientiousness and neuroticism. It is “an openness to being a fool, which is a combination of not worrying about competence, not being self-important, not taking norms as sacred and finding ambiguity and double edges a source of wisdom and delight.”
entries.translation: 有没有经验证据表明玩心确实有益？瑞士心理学家 René Proyer 对成人玩心的研究，比我认识的其他人都深入。他发现，玩心是经验开放性、外向性，以及相对较少尽责性与神经质的结合。文中把它描述为“愿意显得有点傻的开放态度”，包含不那么担心表现能力、不自视过高、不把规范当成神圣，以及从模糊和双重意味中发现智慧与乐趣。

entries.passage: Overall, playful people do not take themselves too seriously, and they seem to know when to take it easy and when to be serious.
entries.translation: 总体而言，有玩心的人不过分严肃地看待自己，而且似乎知道什么时候该放轻松，什么时候该认真。

entries.passage: In a 2013 paper, Proyer found that playful people are slightly more satisfied with their lives than those who are less playful. He also discovered that happy people enjoyed communing with nature, whereas playful people did not. In contrast, happy people did not particularly enjoy going on vacation, whereas playful people did. A recent study randomly assigned some participants to count the playful things they did every day for one week, whereas others did not receive the instructions to count.
entries.translation: 在 2013 年论文中，Proyer 发现，有玩心者比玩心较少者对生活略更满意。他还发现，幸福者享受亲近自然，有玩心者则不然。反过来，幸福者并非特别喜欢度假，有玩心者却喜欢。另一项近期研究把一些参与者随机分派为连续一周每天清点自己做过的有玩心的事；其他人则未收到清点指令。“近期”依原书叙述时点。

entries.passage: Those who tracked their playful experiences reported more life satisfaction and less depression than those in the control group, not only right after the intervention was over but also up to three months later. The authors did not measure meaning or psychological richness, but I suspect that the playfulness intervention would be particularly effective at enhancing psychological richness, as playfulness is likely to bring novel, interesting experiences to one’s life.
entries.translation: 记录玩心经历的人，比对照组报告更多生活满意和更少抑郁，不仅在干预刚结束时如此，最长随访到三个月后也如此。研究者没有测量意义或心理丰富性，但我猜，这种玩心干预对增进心理丰富性可能特别有效，因为玩心很可能带来新奇、有趣的经历。

entries.passage: Like playfulness, spontaneity can enrich our lives. One of the reasons why sitcoms like Friends and Seinfeld remain so popular is that they portray a fantasy world where you can pop in and out of a friend’s apartment anytime you want, no appointment necessary, and do something unplanned every day. If you aren’t naturally spontaneous, making friends like Samantha in Sex and the City can bring playfulness and spontaneity to your life.
entries.translation: 像玩心一样，自发性也能丰富人生。Friends 和 Seinfeld 等情景喜剧持续受欢迎，一个原因是它们描绘幻想世界：随时进出朋友公寓，无须预约，每天都可做没计划的事。如果你天性不随兴，结交像 Sex and the City 中 Samantha 那样的朋友，可能把玩心与自发性带进生活。

entries.passage: Here comes a hard question: When was the last time you went out with someone spontaneously? I still go on some spontaneous outings with my wife when we can, but I haven’t done anything like that with my friends for years. In graduate school, when most of my friends were at school, I would stop by a lab mate’s office and we would go across the street to Espresso Royale for a cup of coffee. Almost every day, I had coffee with someone.
